title: Match
description: End-of-match envelope produced by ClashEngine. One file per finalized match. Combines metadata, ranked outcome, every participant's full stats, and an optional pointer to the replay recording.

schemaVersion.description: Wire format version. Increment on any breaking change. v5 made gameType a registry-name string (was integer) and added participant.ratingAtEnd.

queueName.description: Globally-unique registry id for the queue: "{ownerArena}/{baseName}" for arena-owned queues (e.g. "lobby/casual_4v4"). Stable across renames of the operator-chosen Label.

queueLabel.description: Operator-chosen pretty string for display (e.g. "4v4 (Casual)"). Falls back to the BaseName portion of queueName when no Label is set in clash.conf.

gameType.description: GameType identifier (registry name). The consumer resolves the name to a specific GameType version at ingest time and stamps the resolved version on the stored match record.

arena.description: SubspaceServer arena the match was played in.

startedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the match transitioned from forming to live. Null if the match never went live (cancelled before start).

endedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the match was finalized.

teams.description: Teams ranked by outcome (rank 1 first). For Cancelled matches this may be empty.

participants.description: Every player who was registered for this match's stats accounting, including subs.

abandonedBy.description: Names of players who caused the match to be flagged for abandonment (mid-match leavers, no-shows, or otherwise tracked for queue-timeout penalties). Multiple players from either team can appear in the same match; the list is a flat, unordered set rather than partitioned by team. Empty for non-abandoned matches.

recordingPath.description: Optional pointer to the SubspaceServer replay file for this match. Relative path; the binary itself is uploaded out-of-band.

rank.description: 1 = winner. Ties resolve by team-index ascending.

score.description: Team kill count or other end-policy metric (KOTH defenses, etc.).

players.description: Player names on this team. Order matches the queue's slot order.

gamesPlayed.description: Number of games played in this game type prior to this match.

teamIndex.description: Team this player started on (0-based). -1 if registered after match start without a team assignment.

ratingAtStart.description: Player's rating at the moment the match started, frozen here so the upload reflects pre-match skill (the live store updates on outcome).

ratingAtEnd.description: Player's rating after the match was finalized. The receiving store uses this as the canonical post-match value (no μ/σ derivation on the consumer side). Null when either pre-match or post-match rating is unavailable (e.g. cancelled match, unranked participant, or a participant the engine never tracked).

ratingChange.description: Change in rating produced by this match, expressed in displayed-ordinal units (same scale as μ−3σ ×10). Positive = gained ranking points. Null when either pre-match or post-match rating is unavailable (e.g. cancelled match, unranked participant, or a participant the engine never tracked).

knockouts.description: Final deaths: deaths that exhausted the player's last life. Bounded by the queue's lives-per-player.

assists.description: Kills credited via decay-weighted damage share ≥ 25% of victim max energy. Killer never receives an assist.

damageDealt.description: Raw damage to enemies, summed face-value (no decay).

selfDamage.description: Damage you inflicted on yourself (e.g. own bomb splash). Not added to recovery state.

teamDamageDealt.description: Friendly fire — raw damage to teammates. Splash and Thor only in practice.

killDamage.description: Raw (non-decay-weighted) damage this player accumulated to trigger victim deaths: sum of recovery-adjusted damage shares contributed across every kill the player was involved in. Includes friendly-fire contributions per the agreed denominator rule.

killCredit.description: Kill participation: each death distributes 1.0 credit across contributing attackers in proportion to their decay-weighted damage share. Sum across all attackers for one kill = 1.0; this is one player's tally. Decay weighting (exp(-(dt/halfLife) * ln 2)) is applied to determine each attacker's share before normalization.

forcedRepelDamage.description: Raw (non-decay-weighted) damage this player accumulated to trigger enemy repels: sum of recovery-adjusted damage shares contributed across every repel event.

forcedRepelCredit.description: Forced-repel participation: each repel event distributes 1.0 credit across contributing attackers in proportion to their decay-weighted damage share. Sum across all attackers for one repel = 1.0; this is one player's tally. Analogous to killCredit but triggered by repels rather than deaths.

perWeapon.description: Per-weapon shot accounting. Keys are weapon kinds; missing keys mean zero activity. Splash weapons can produce multiple hits per shot, so hit-rate may exceed 100%.

itemUses.description: Item-use counters keyed by item kind.

wastedItems.description: Items the player gained but never used over the entire match. Each closed life contributes its leftover inventory (initial loadout + green pickups − uses) at close-time; over a multi-life match the totals accumulate. Same key set as itemUses.

distanceSamples.description: Distance-to-nearest-enemy samples taken at regular intervals while the player is in-arena. Distance is in pixels (SubspaceServer's native position unit; 16 px = 1 tile). Cadence is server-configured via [ClashEngine] DistanceSampleHz (default 5 Hz).

lives.description: Per-life subrecord. A life starts at spawn and ends only via these reasons; ship and freq changes are not life transitions.

hitCount.description: One increment per opponent damage event. For splash weapons, a single shot that damages N enemies counts N hits.

energySpent.description: Sum of base + (level-1)*upgrade + multifire surcharge across all fired shots.

tick.description: Server tick (10 ms granularity) at which the sample was taken.

distance.description: Distance in pixels to the nearest live enemy at sample time.

startTick.description: Server tick (10 ms granularity) when the life began.

endTick.description: Server tick when the life ended. Null if the life was still open at upload time (shouldn't happen for completed matches).

knockoutBy.description: Player who closed this life (the killer). Null when not applicable.

shipAtEnd.description: Ship the player was in when this life ended (at death, or at match-end before being specced). Null if the ship was never observed.
